name: Matrix Hearts
source:
He was supposed to be somebody. He was going to be a contender! Then he took a rock climbing wall to the knee.

A would-be Olympic climber sustains an injury to his leg that keeps him from competing and a shot at the big leagues, with the only possible fix being a prototype technology that is sci-fi at best. Between his new introverted mood, a town of colorful characters, and the fruits of temptation, getting this tech to work may require all he's got.

There's a big cliff to climb for him to be a champion again!​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/blueottergames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
他本该闯出一番名堂，本该成为争夺冠军的强者！直到有一天，他的膝盖撞上了攀岩墙。

一名有望参加奥运会的攀岩运动员腿部受伤，失去了参赛和跻身顶尖赛场的机会。唯一可能治好他的，是一项怎么看都像科幻产物的原型技术。面对自己变得封闭的性格、镇上形形色色的人物，以及诱惑的果实，要让这项技术奏效，恐怕得使出浑身解数。

要再次成为冠军，他还有一面陡峭的绝壁需要攀越！

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/blueottergames]Patreon[/url]]
